models_evaluated: previously developed machine learning suicide attempt prediction model (90-day)

links.outcome: Performance of existing suicide attempt model on local historical intake data against reference outcomes
links.effect: AUROC 0.77 (95% CI 0.76-0.78); AUPRC 0.02; sensitivity 37.2% at 95% specificity, 18.8% at 99% specificity; top 10% risk captured 48.8% of attempts.
links.quote: The model had an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.77 (95% CI, 0.76-0.78), an area under the precision-recall curve of 0.02 (95% CI, 0.02-0.02), an expected calibration error of 0.0012 (95% CI, 0.0011-0.0013), and sensitivities of 37.2% (95% CI, 35.5%-38.9%) and 18.8% (95% CI, 17.3%-20.2%) at specificities of 95% and 99%, respectively.

links.outcome: Model performance when extended to a new use context (intake appointments)
links.effect: Model developed for any outpatient mental health visit showed good overall classification at intake (AUROC 0.77), but very low precision (AUPRC 0.02) given 0.17% base rate.
links.quote: In this prognostic study involving mental health intakes, a previously developed machine learning model of suicide attempts showed good overall classification performance.

screen.reason: Retrospective external/setting validation of a previously developed suicide risk prediction model specifically applied to mental health intake visits.
